recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片（trephine）中，骨小樑之間幾乎被紫藍色的造血細胞填滿，只剩少數小脂肪空泡，屬於明顯高細胞密度（hypercellular）骨髓；單看這張低倍圖無法判斷細胞種類，需要搭配免疫染色才能確認骨髓瘤。
features: Low-power H&E view of an intact bone marrow trephine core with multiple bony trabeculae
Intertrabecular spaces markedly hypercellular, filled by sheets of hematopoietic/infiltrating cells
Adipocytes reduced to small scattered vacuoles; no large fat spaces
Trabeculae of roughly normal thickness without obvious lytic scalloping at this magnification
Cell lineage and plasma cell content cannot be assessed at this power
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows an adequate core with numerous bony trabeculae. The intertrabecular spaces are markedly hypercellular with only small, scattered fat vacuoles, indicating near-complete loss of normal marrow fat for age. Cellular composition cannot be resolved at this magnification, and high-power examination with immunohistochemistry (e.g., CD138, light chains) is required. In the stated clinical context, the findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow involved by plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with normal maturation and no clonal plasma cell clusters on CD138 and kappa/lambda staining.
MPNs show panmyelosis with atypical clustered megakaryocytes and often reticulin fibrosis rather than a CD138-positive, light chain-restricted plasma cell infiltrate.
Acute leukemia replaces the marrow with sheets of blasts (CD34/CD117/TdT positive) rather than mature-appearing plasma cells.
